definitions.explanation: A concise reference book that organizes essential information on a subject for quick lookup. Often used for practical, technical, or educational purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{便覧|べんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look something up in a chemistry handbook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{便覧|べんらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履修|りしゅう}→履修：04861_rishuu⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っている→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: The course registration process is listed in the student handbook.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{便覧|べんらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{統計|とうけい}→統計：04271_toukei⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく⟦まとめられている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: This reference guide compiles Japan's statistical data in an easy-to-understand format.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (convenient) and {覧|らん} (viewing/reading). Implies a practical, quick-reference publication rather than an in-depth textbook.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧{便覧|べんらん}: chemistry handbook
- ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{便覧|べんらん}: student handbook
- ⟦{統計|とうけい}→統計：04271_toukei⟧{便覧|べんらん}: statistical compendium
- {便覧|べんらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to consult a handbook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハンドブック: handbook (loanword) — more commonly used in modern everyday contexts
- ⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧: manual — implies step-by-step instructions rather than quick reference
- ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: dictionary/encyclopedia — organized alphabetically or by topic with fuller entries
- {要覧|ようらん}: summary guide — similar format but emphasizes giving an overview
